CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Trusted;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.description: Formula to show Status + Icon on ListViews and Standard Related Lists.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT( Sub_Status__c ) , "Failed", IMAGE("/resource/StatusIcons/clear.svg", "Failed", 16, 16) + " " + TEXT(Status) , "Success", IMAGE("/resource/StatusIcons/success.svg", "Success", 16, 16) + " " + TEXT(Status), "Processing", IMAGE("/resource/StatusIcons/spinner.svg", "Processing", 16, 16) + " " + TEXT(Status), TEXT(Status))
CustomField.label: Status
